subject: Chemistry
question_text: The surface of sodium metal is irradiated with radiation of wavelength λ nm. The kinetic energy of ejected electrons is 2.8 × 10⁻²⁰ J. The work function of sodium is 2.3 eV. The value of λ is x × 10² nm (nearest integer). Given h = 6.6 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, 1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J and c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹. Find x.
solution: Photon energy = work function + maximum kinetic energy = 2.3(1.6×10⁻¹⁹)+2.8×10⁻²⁰ = 3.96×10⁻¹⁹ J. Then λ=hc/E=(6.6×10⁻³⁴)(3.0×10⁸)/(3.96×10⁻¹⁹)=5.0×10⁻⁷ m=500 nm=5×10² nm, so x=5.

subject: Chemistry
question_text: Consider the gas-phase reaction 2A(g) → 4B(g) + C(g) in a closed vessel at 25°C. The total pressure is 300 mm Hg after 30 minutes and 600 mm Hg at completion. The pressure of C(g) after 30 minutes is ______ mm Hg (nearest integer).
solution: Initially the vessel contains A only. At completion, 2 moles of A produce 5 total moles, so P∞=(5/2)P₀=600 and P₀=240 mm Hg. At 30 min, P/P₀=300/240=1.25=1+1.5α, giving α=1/6. The partial pressure of C is P_C=P₀(α/2)=240/12=20 mm Hg.

subject: Chemistry
question_text: Consider the half-cell reactions CO₂ + 6H⁺ + 6e⁻ → CH₃OH + H₂O, E°red = 0.02 V, and ½O₂ + 2H⁺ + 2e⁻ → H₂O, E°red = 1.23 V. A fuel cell uses these reactions at 1 bar and 298 K with 80% efficiency. If the work obtained using 1 mol of CH₃OH is used to compress an ideal gas isothermally against a constant pressure of 1 kPa, find the magnitude of the gas volume change ΔV in m³ (nearest integer). Take F = 96500 C mol⁻¹.
solution: E°cell=1.23−0.02=1.21 V and n=6. The maximum electrical work magnitude is nFE=6×96500×1.21=700590 J mol⁻¹. At 80% efficiency, useful work is 560472 J. For constant external pressure, W=P|ΔV|; with P=1000 Pa, |ΔV|=560472/1000≈560 m³.

subject: Chemistry
question_text: How many of the following ions are paramagnetic? Mn²⁺, Cu²⁺, Zn²⁺, Yb²⁺, Sc³⁺, La³⁺, Gd³⁺, Lu³⁺, Ti⁴⁺ and Ce⁴⁺. Atomic numbers: Mn=25, Cu=29, Zn=30, Yb=70, Sc=21, La=57, Gd=64, Lu=71, Ti=22, Ce=58.
solution: Mn²⁺ is 3d⁵, Cu²⁺ is 3d⁹, and Gd³⁺ is 4f⁷; each has unpaired electrons and is paramagnetic. Zn²⁺ (3d¹⁰), Yb²⁺ (4f¹⁴), Sc³⁺ (d⁰), La³⁺ (f⁰), Lu³⁺ (4f¹⁴), Ti⁴⁺ (d⁰), and Ce⁴⁺ (f⁰) are diamagnetic. Count = 3.

subject: Chemistry
question_text: Consider the reaction sequence shown in the diagram for p-nitrotoluene: (i) Sn/HCl; OH⁻, (ii) (CH₃CO)₂O, (iii) Br₂/AlBr₃, (iv) H₃O⁺. When product P is subjected to Carius analysis using AgNO₃, 1.0 g of P produces ______ g of AgBr precipitate (nearest integer). Atomic masses: C=12, H=1, O=16, N=14, Br=80, Ag=108.
solution: Reduction converts the nitro group to an amino group; acetylation protects it during bromination. Hydrolysis restores the amino group, giving a monobrominated toluidine, C₇H₈BrN (molar mass 186 g mol⁻¹). One mole of product gives one mole of AgBr (188 g mol⁻¹), so 1.0 g product gives 188/186≈1.01 g AgBr, nearest integer 1 g.
